policy: Blocking errors prevent submission editing of the affected statement. Required nonblocking changes must be completed during lead reconciliation but do not retract the surviving finite theorem. Strengthening suggestions improve precision or reproducibility and do not count as closure criteria unless the lead promotes them into a governing obligation. Every item remains OPEN until exact acceptance evidence is hash-bound and reviewed.

blocking_errors.title: Replace or retract the representable external-product witness
blocking_errors.finding: For H(c,V)=yC_0(c) x F_A(V), the null-cover condition at (c,empty) requires Hom_C(c,C_0) to be singleton for every c. A general representable is therefore not a J_A-sheaf, and duplicated representable coordinates also obstruct gluing over split contexts.
blocking_errors.required_action: Either keep ambient distinctness OPEN or replace the representable factor with the terminal C-presheaf after defining the exact lifted L-coordinate topology, stating C nonempty, and checking the witness naturally in both coordinates. Do not infer product-site commutation or J_obs interaction.
blocking_errors.acceptance_evidence: Corrected lead-owned text and claim/evidence records plus a reviewed proof or executable product-site fixture that includes the null cover and general C-coordinate restrictions.

blocking_errors.title: Narrow the finite-dimensional cellular-Laplacian claim
blocking_errors.finding: Finite dimensionality is not a universal prerequisite for a cellular-sheaf Laplacian. Bounded Hilbert-valued cellular sheaves can have bounded Laplacians in infinite dimension, and the cited Hansen-Ghrist source discusses that case.
blocking_errors.required_action: State finite-dimensional real or complex stalks as a requirement of the selected finite executable/matrix-certificate profile. Preserve the valid universal requirements for an explicit linear or Hilbert representation, structure maps, and declared adjoint/inner-product data.
blocking_errors.acceptance_evidence: Corrected Paper 4, claim-matrix, and citation-ledger wording reviewed against the primary source, with no remaining universal finite-dimensional assertion.

blocking_errors.title: Correct the PUB-P2-007 evidence edge
blocking_errors.finding: PUB-P2-007 is grouped with the finite-site and Lean seed nodes, but its actual join-equality proof and exhaustive topology execution are in EVD-MODALITY-PROOF and EVD-MODALITY-EXECUTION. The Lean seed explicitly excludes topology generation and reflector formalization.
blocking_errors.required_action: Give PUB-P2-007 its own edge to EVD-MODALITY-PROOF and EVD-MODALITY-EXECUTION. Remove or narrowly qualify EVD-LEAN-SEED from any edge where it appears to support topology, representable-sheaf, witness, join, or reflector claims beyond its registered lemmas.
blocking_errors.acceptance_evidence: JSON-valid corrected evidence map with all 20 claims mapped, no unknown or duplicate IDs, and reviewer-confirmed evidence scopes.

strengthening_suggestions.title: Split evidence edges by claim rather than by broad cluster
strengthening_suggestions.suggestion: Use one edge per claim or per genuinely identical evidence scope. This prevents a bounded Lean seed or one executable certificate from appearing to support every claim in a heterogeneous cluster.
